subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should the Feishu reply-anchor fix land through the open broad anchor PR, a narrowed replacement, or a separate explicit-`replyTo` patch?
rationale: Current source shows a real bug, but an open proof-positive PR already overlaps the area and existing labels ask ClawSweeper not to spawn a new independent fix without maintainer coordination.

options.title: Coordinate through the open anchor PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the first landing path if its author or a maintainer can resolve the conflicts and narrow remaining risks.

options.title: Open a narrow replacement
options.body: If the open PR stalls, queue a credited narrow replacement that only maps explicit `replyTo` through Feishu ordinary sends and adds focused regression tests.

options.title: Leave as issue-only for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open without repair work until maintainers collect live Feishu proof that distinguishes explicit `replyTo` loss from the broader `replies=0` failure.

recommendation.title: Coordinate through the open anchor PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the first landing path if its author or a maintainer can resolve the conflicts and narrow remaining risks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu message-tool/media and native-card work makes this the strongest owner signal for choosing the landing path.
